segments.text: Um, so, your asthma has been, uh, quite bad this week.
I'm going to give you prednisolone, fifteen milligrams, once daily, er, for five days.
And use your salbutamol inhaler, two puffs, when you need it.
If you get very short of breath, go to the hospital straight away.
Uh, see me again in two weeks, on Friday.
